name: Lintel
description: Checks the files of a project against a few fixed rules and lists what it finds with the problems of the editor. Colors its own config files.

permissions.files.read: Reads the files of the project it checks
permissions.languages.servers: Adds a language server for its config files when you ask
permissions.problems.provide: Lists what it finds with the problems of the editor
permissions.projects.read: Checks a project while you have it open
permissions.clock: Checks every open project again every five minutes
